purpose: Immutable self-scoped idempotency receipt for the first B02 accepted floating-local Activity Schedule establishment operation; operation identity remains separate from Activity, Schedule and MaterialState identity.

columns.name: self_person_ref
columns.meaning: Authenticated self Person scope owning the operation receipt.

columns.name: operation_id
columns.meaning: Client/application operation identity used only for idempotent mutation replay.

columns.name: intent_fingerprint
columns.meaning: Deterministic fingerprint of the materially relevant establishment command intent.

columns.name: subject_native_ref
columns.meaning: Activity NativeRef targeted by the first B02 Schedule establishment capability.
columns.value_contract: B02-A routine accepts only an Activity owned by self_person_ref.

columns.name: schedule_ref
columns.meaning: Stable Schedule ScopedRecordRef created by the accepted operation.
columns.value_contract: Application-issued UUIDv7 and unique per receipt.

columns.name: material_state_ref
columns.meaning: Exact accepted schedule.placement MaterialStateRef created by the operation.
columns.value_contract: Application-issued UUIDv7 and unique per receipt.

columns.name: created_at
columns.meaning: Authoritative transaction timestamp recorded with the accepted operation.
columns.value_contract: statement_timestamp() captured by the bounded database capability.

primary_key.name: pk_schedule_establish_operation
primary_key.reason: One immutable receipt per self-scoped operation identity.

foreign_keys.name: fk_schedule_establish_operation_self_person_ref_person
foreign_keys.semantic_reason: Bind operation scope to the native self Person.

foreign_keys.name: fk_schedule_establish_operation_subject_native_ref_native_address
foreign_keys.semantic_reason: Bind the command subject to the bounded native-address space; the capability further restricts it to Activity.

foreign_keys.name: fk_schedule_establish_operation_schedule_ref_schedule
foreign_keys.semantic_reason: Bind the receipt to the exact Schedule owner created by the operation.

foreign_keys.name: fk_schedule_establish_operation_material_state_ref_placement_state
foreign_keys.semantic_reason: Bind replay to the exact accepted schedule.placement MaterialState.

unique_constraints.name: uq_schedule_establish_operation_schedule_ref
unique_constraints.reason: A created Schedule belongs to one establishment receipt.

unique_constraints.name: uq_schedule_establish_operation_material_state_ref
unique_constraints.reason: A created placement MaterialState belongs to one establishment receipt.

check_constraints.name: ck_schedule_establish_operation_operation_id
check_constraints.reason: Keep the bounded operation identity canonical and non-empty.

check_constraints.name: ck_schedule_establish_operation_fingerprint
check_constraints.reason: Require the exact deterministic SHA-256 hex fingerprint representation.

indexes.name: pk_schedule_establish_operation
indexes.reason: Idempotent replay lookup by self scope and operation id.

indexes.name: uq_schedule_establish_operation_schedule_ref
indexes.reason: Enforce one receipt per created Schedule.

indexes.name: uq_schedule_establish_operation_material_state_ref
indexes.reason: Enforce one receipt per created placement MaterialState.

indexes.name: ix_schedule_establish_operation_subject_native_ref
indexes.reason: Support subject-bound receipt integrity and operational inspection without defining Schedule identity.

state_history.material_state_behavior: The receipt references, but is not itself, the accepted schedule.placement MaterialState.
state_history.current_binding: Replay verifies that the receipt still resolves through the exact current Schedule placement created by the establishment operation.
state_history.chronology: Receipt creation uses the same transaction timestamp as the initial Schedule current-history episode.
state_history.immutability_policy: Existing receipts are replay-only; operation-id reuse with materially different intent is rejected.

lifecycle.delete_behavior: No direct runtime delete or read capability; downgrade refuses removal after canonical Schedule establishment receipts exist.

obligations: runtime has no direct table read/write privilege on operation receipts
each accepted receipt binds one self Person, Activity, Schedule and exact placement MaterialState
same operation id and same material intent replays while different intent conflicts
receipt existence never becomes Schedule or MaterialState identity
